title: The wave 4 journey harness environment, seed, evidence format and gate are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 3, 20, 38, 41, 42, 43, 44 and 46; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 and 28; Recovery Workbench Program v4 section 8
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the harness environment, its repository, its base hosts and its namespace, the seeded portfolio and its identifiers (two cases, the lot, the accounts, the write-off, the partner and the instruction), the business date and the cut-off month the journey fixes, the gateway-bff composite route paths and their merge order, the evidence format and its retention, the wave gate name and its thresholds, or the synthetic-data reset procedure. The sources give the owners, the operations, the events, the jobs, the states and the rules only: rwb-debtsale, rwb-writeoff, rwb-partner, rwb-deviation and rwb-integration as the five owners the wave 4 journey drives, rwb-case, rwb-source-data, rwb-decision and rwb-access as the platform owners, and Architecture v5 slide 46 as the statement that a daily journey smoke workflow exists.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners and operations only, Arch v5 slides 41 to 44 give topics, events, jobs and waves only, and the Program release plan gives release dates only
proposed: Agree the harness environment, the seeded portfolio and its identifiers, the fixed business date and cut-off month, the composite route paths, and the wave 4 evidence format, retention and gate with QA and the integration lead at the wave entry check; build against the stub set until each owner lands.
